title: On Modality Bias Recognition and Reduction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance degradation on newly constructed Out-of-Distribution (OoD) datasets (e.g., OoD Colored MNIST, OoD Kinetics) where the spurious correlations between a specific modality (such as color or static object frames) and the target label are removed. The paper also evaluates the predictions of wrong instances by computing the Jensen-Shannon Divergence between the model's output distribution and the biased training label distribution.

Measuring the accuracy of Visual Question Answering (VQA) models on VQA-CP (Changing Priors) datasets, where the language prior shortcut is severed by ensuring the answer distribution for each question type is significantly different between the training and testing sets.
